sources.title: What Is Agentic AI? Definition, 6 Levels & Examples (2026)
sources.snippet: What Is Agentic AI? Agentic AI is artificial intelligence that pursues goals on its own. Unlike a chatbot that only generates text, an agentic AI plans steps, calls real tools (APIs, files, browsers, code), watches what happens, and adjusts — looping until a task is done. sources.title: GPT‑5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
sources.snippet: Efficient by default, maximum performance on demand GPT‑5.6 Sol is our best coding model yet.
